lines.t: Sometimes I feel like I am back behind the wheel
Just driving circles in the dark, trying to feel something real
I used to think that I was fine, just steering on my own
But every map I drew myself just left me more alone
Yeah, I was tired of the road I paved in stone
It's like a fog that settles deep inside my weary mind
I'm looking for a signpost that I'm never gonna find
But then a voice breaks through the static of the radio
Telling me it's time to finally let the heavy burden go
And let a greater love take over the control
Whatever tomorrow brings, I'll be there
With open arms and a heart of prayer
I'm giving up the lead, I'm stepping off the ledge
And I'll be there with open arms
It's funny how the fear begins to fade into the light
When I'm no longer white-knuckled trying to win the fight
There's a comfort in the silence, a peace I can't explain
Like the sun breaking the clouds right in the middle of the rain
I'm finally finding joy inside the strain
Whatever tomorrow brings, I'll be there
With open arms and a heart of prayer
I'm giving up the land
I'm stepping off the ledge
And I'll be there
With open arms
I'm letting go of the line
I'm letting go of the lies
I'm finally alive
With open arms
With open arms
Let's open up
Let's open up
Let's open up
I don't need it, I don't need it
I don't need it, I don't need it
